question: Which initiative under the National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (NAFCC) focuses on community-led water harvesting in semi-arid regions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Climate Resilient Watershed Programme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Climate Resilient Watershed Programme** is an initiative under the **National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (NAFCC)** aimed at addressing climate vulnerabilities in semi-arid and drought-prone regions.
 
• This programme focuses on **community-led water harvesting** techniques and sustainable water management practices to enhance water availability and resilience against climate change.
 
• The programme supports the adoption of **climate-resilient agriculture** by improving water availability and ensuring the efficient use of water resources, especially in regions facing water scarcity. *Hence, this is the correct answer.*
 
• The initiative emphasizes involving local communities in the planning and implementation of water conservation measures, ensuring long-term sustainability and inclusivity in its approach.
